subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose provider channel creation through the message tool/CLI, and what explicit admin gate or requester authorization must protect Slack and Discord workspace/server mutations?
rationale: Channel creation lets agents mutate provider-side workspace/server structure, and current message.action is an operator.write method; automation cannot safely choose the permanent authority boundary.

options.title: Approve explicit admin-gated provider implementation
options.body: Add provider-owned channel creation behind default-off admin/channel gates, with Slack setup/docs/scopes, Discord CLI/tool wiring, and tests for both allowed and denied paths.

options.title: Limit scope to Discord CLI for now
options.body: Land or replace the focused Discord CLI subcommand work while keeping Slack channel creation and broader admin actions blocked until a separate Slack security design is approved.

options.title: Decline native channel creation for now
options.body: Keep channel creation as an external provider/API workflow and document that OpenClaw message actions do not manage workspace/server structure yet.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit admin-gated provider implementation
recommendation.body: Add provider-owned channel creation behind default-off admin/channel gates, with Slack setup/docs/scopes, Discord CLI/tool wiring, and tests for both allowed and denied paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue’s exact surfaces and current history points to Peter Steinberger on the affected current-main files.
